product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Sunburst Lines Hanging Wall Mirror Decor, 20 Inch Height, Antique Gold Finish
product.description: Strips of metal with an antiqued gold finished come from all directions and unite in the center to form a sunburst effect. This small, square mirror is perfect to decorate a small space or add a pop of shine to a gallery wall. 20" x 20" Modern design with touch of glam Glass, iron with gold finish Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
